title: Prediction
description: What `breakingnews run` emits: one object per document. Deliberately the same offset convention as an annotation, so a prediction file and a gold file can be scored against each other without conversion.

word_count.description: Length of the transcript this was predicted from, in words. Lets a consumer verify the prediction was made against the same text they hold.

pred_breaks.description: Predicted word offsets of new-story starts, ascending, after guard filtering and cross-window deduplication. Same convention as an annotation's `breaks`.

tau.description: Threshold applied to P("1") to produce `pred_breaks`. Recorded so a prediction file is self-describing.

n_unlocatable_anchors.description: Anchors the model emitted that could not be grounded back to a word offset in their window. Counted, never silently dropped: a rising count means the model is paraphrasing rather than quoting, which is a failure mode worth seeing.

n_ambiguous_anchors.description: Anchors whose pre-context matched at more than one position in the window. Resolved to the first match by default. Reported because the rate has never been measured; 12 pre-context words are unique for 99.93% of annotated breaks, so it should be near zero.

outlet.description: Passed through from the input, if present.

show.description: Passed through from the input, if present.

date.description: Passed through from the input, if present.

adapter.description: Adapter the run used, as passed on the command line.

adapter_revision.description: Hub revision the adapter was pinned to, or null for `main`. Null means the weights are not identified: re-running later can load different ones with no error. Pin it for anything whose numbers will be published.
